title: decode: base64 decode falls back to raw body bytes on error, not empty/error
description: In decode.rs, when BASE64_STANDARD.decode() fails for a Base64-encoded part, the fallback is String::from_utf8_lossy(body_bytes).into_owned().into_bytes() — returning the raw (still base64-encoded) body bytes as if they were the decoded content, with is_encoding_problem=true. A caller that ignores is_encoding_problem will receive base64 gibberish as the decoded text value. RFC 2045 §6.8 does not specify a fallback for invalid base64 — returning the raw bytes as decoded text is misleading and will propagate corrupted data silently if the caller does not check is_encoding_problem.
